body: Hide, not fade: camera domain sets Visibility::Hidden on the Player body root (model + joint-parented held gun inherit it) with hysteresis hide_player_distance / hide_player_band in camera.ron; state = the current Visibility, no extra field. Rejected: material-alpha fade (AlphaMode::Blend on per-character tinted materials plus the gun materials shared by every armed NPC -> per-player material clones, sorting artifacts, far more code for a first-frame-visible defect); writing CharacterModel Visibility (already owned by visuals hide_driver_model, two writers would fight).

hide_player_distance 1.4 m, band 0.3 m: TASK-031 orbit tables show 0.50 m (90-150 deg), 0.97/1.2 m (180/210 deg, model still covers a third of the frame), aim camera sits at ~2.83 m and open at ~3.9 m, so 1.4..1.7 hides every pushed-in pose and never the aim/open camera. Measured point = player body Transform (same as the probe cam_distance). Alternative rejected: threshold ~0.8 m (misses the 0.97-1.2 m frames, and the minimum reachable distance with the shoulder unblocked is ~0.94 m).

QA car-at-wall probe: teleported a parked car (Position+Rotation over BRP) parallel to the found wall 1.7 m out instead of driving one into the wall; driving to a wall over BRP keys is slow and non-deterministic. Consequence: the car camera never pushed below 2.36 m to the seat, so the body root was never Hidden while driving; the exit case is covered as 'visible after exit' on seeds 1/7, not as 'hidden in car -> exit'.
